svg.title: The frame multiplying Ng by R and fixing its complement has determinant Rνg, while fR composed with it is R−νgf. These cancel exactly. The one-root budget becomes Ru−ωg−ε, where u = 0 for the full reading, u = h for degree-h output and u = h + 1 for remainder through h. Thus Z ∥Ks(fR)(x)∥dx ≤C∥f∥CN{g}Ru−ωg−ε. (CE18)
